svg.title: LexaVault case processing flow
svg.text: Waits · a person or a destination
file waits at its source, nothing lost
typed pages read directly, scanned pages by OCR
big documents split into page batches
case gate: every document read and searched
each finding, add boxes by hand,
check pages that can’t be read.
A page the reviewer finished is
every box dark · page count same
no hidden value in any page’s text or the file
Also: a job retried past its
read the finished file again, rules + vision
independent AI reading · if the entity turns it on
the whole case to the master destination
a “duplicate” answer is recorded, never retried
Split documents to their own destinations
after the admin’s period: 24 h by default, never over 7 days
audit trail and Reports, no document content
